question: Should this dashboard agent-status widget be accepted now as a sessions.list-backed builtin, or should it wait for the broader sessions.activity contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent and fits web-frontend ergonomics, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, run progress, attention, and cross-agent state is a product/API sequencing decision.

options.title: Review linked dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution and close this issue only after it lands or is replaced.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 lands a richer sessions.activity source, then build the widget against that stable API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing only if this issue's status-widget requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Review linked dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution and close this issue only after it lands or is replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner signal for deciding the dashboard/plugin-tab and gateway-session API sequencing tradeoff from the current history checked.
